description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Bloom Tender.
Activate Volrath by tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{G}{U}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Knacksaw Clique.
